Q: independensoft.msg doesn't handle special characters A:

In line

html_body_with_rtf = "{\\rtf1\\ansi\\ansicpg1252\\fromhtml1 \\htmlrtf0 " + html_body + "}"

I see CPG1252 which suggests that it may need encoding cp1252 instead of utf-8

rtf_body = html_body_with_rtf.encode("cp1252")

Q: Using Hamcrest `closeTo` with a float A:

Remove is(). It resolved to <T>is(T) overload instead of <T>is(Matcher<T>) and expects your operand to be equal to a Matcher object.

Hamcrest should probably detect the problem in runtime and provide a nicer diagnostic. Consider requesting a feature.

Q: How to store attribute values of a selected object as a variable in Maya A:

This error is happening because you are calling the string "objectnameplaceholder" that doesn't exists in your current scene, instead of calling your variable.

Try this:

import maya.cmds as cmds

objectnameplaceholder = cmds.ls(sl=True)
obj_TX = cmds.getAttr(f"{objectnameplaceholder[0]}.translateX")
obj_TY = cmds.getAttr(f"{objectnameplaceholder[0]}.translateY")
obj_TZ = cmds.getAttr(f"{objectnameplaceholder[0]}.translateZ")
obj_RX = cmds.getAttr(f"{objectnameplaceholder[0]}.rotateX")
obj_RY = cmds.getAttr(f"{objectnameplaceholder[0]}.rotateY")
obj_RZ = cmds.getAttr(f"{objectnameplaceholder[0]}.rotateZ")
print(objectnameplaceholder)

Q: Excel VBA Doesnt Send Email with .Display but does with .Send A:

The Issue was using the New Outlook app, reverting to Classic Outlook allowed .Display to send the email and consequently the other 22 attempted emails. Thank you so much everyone for your help and Siddharth Rout for the solution.

Note: This occurs since new Outlook doesn't fully support traditional COM automation like Classic Outlook did.

Q: Session lost when switching language on Joomla 2.5 A:

The problem was not in the core of Joomla. The problem was in a module (which I developed myself) and made ​​a session_destroy(). In addition, this module was assigned to all menu items in Spanish.
